question: XSLE is related to AWOI in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JIXU is related to MMAY. To which of the following options is SUGG related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, XSLE is related to AWOI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18ea633bd3c4ea23417b59566febf10a5e0c073b0b5c7462a09fe68aa7e29fcf.png] 

For, JIXU is related to MMAY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac3f40c3b62f1121deea483af03c4227020a5347177719e6e80583bc1ededcd2.png] 

Similarly, for **SUGG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/337827b779ad3f7e2ab027f22bce3adfcf3d7473f60354ff38b44903b1919503.png]
